question.:question/problem: Find the slope of $y=f(x)$ at $x=\frac{\pi }{3}$ if $f(x)=\frac{\sec x}{\sqrt{3}}+\frac{19{x}^{2}}{\pi }.$

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\frac{\sec x}{\sqrt{3}}+\frac{19{x}^{2}}{\pi }) \\  & =\frac{\sec x\tan x}{\sqrt{3}}+\frac{38x}{\pi }\end{aligned}
